title: docs(desktop): default profile takes precedence over the launch toggle
claim: The launch-preference docs omit that a default profile takes precedence; desktop.md also names a non-existent 'Open on launch' control.

evidence.red: desktop.md:470 on main: "**Open on launch** keeps the backward-compatible **Primary gateway** default, or can resume the **Last used** gateway"; multi-connection-desktop.md:61-65 and :239-240 describe the last-used toggle with no default-profile caveat.
evidence.green: desktop.md names the real toggle 'At startup, return to Sessions on the last-used gateway' and says a profile marked Set as default takes precedence; multi-connection-desktop.md bullets add the same precedence; grep 'Open on launch' returns nothing.
evidence.negative_control: N/A for docs (no executable behaviour). Equivalent check: the stale phrase is present on main and absent on the bundle (grep given in red/green).
evidence.adjacent: python3 website/scripts/check_doc_links.py on the bundle tree: OK (no route-style links). All 7 B1 bundles cherry-pick together onto main cleanly, and each pairs cleanly with B2's current docs2-update/docs2-desktop/docs2-gateway/docs2-memory bundles.
evidence.source: apps/desktop/src/store/connections.ts:255-279 follows $defaultProfileRoute before reading registry.launchMode; apps/desktop/electron/main.ts:15279-15284,15609 connects the default route at startup; i18n en.ts:1529-1530 launchModeTitle is the only launch control (connections-registry.tsx:917-920); no 'Open on launch' string exists.

upstream_overlap: No open external PR/issue for this claim (gh search prs/issues; open docs PRs touching the same files edit other sections)

bundle.subject: docs(desktop): sync timeline rail, Simple-mode rail, square menu and launch precedence
